parts.text: In what ways did you use or challenge conventions in your production work?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate one of your productions using the concept of representation. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: To what extent does media regulation reflect its period? [50]
OR
‘It is impossible to regulate the media effectively.’ Discuss this view. [50]
Global media
‘The positives of global media outweigh the negatives.’ How far do you agree with this view? [50]
OR
To what extent have global media created global culture? [50]
Media and collective identity
‘People don’t want positive or negative representations of themselves – they want complexity.’
How far do you agree with this statement? [50]
OR
In what ways are representations of specific social groups resistant to change? [50]
Media in the online age
To what extent have online media revolutionised traditional media? [50]
OR
‘We are all producers in the online age.’ Assess the evidence to support this statement. [50]
Postmodern media
‘Everything is playful in the postmodern text.’ Discuss this view. [50]
OR
What, for you, is the most useful way of understanding postmodern media? [50]
